title: Summary of tax update 2026: simplification, modernisation and fairness
text: The government has announced a package of tax and customs measures on 23 June 2026 to reduce administrative burdens, improve certainty, fairness, customer experience and allowing businesses to focus on growth.
changeNote: Links added to the modernising the distributions framework consultation, call for evidence on Customs Modernisation and  the Improving the Quality of Customs Intermediaries consultation.
